title: Expose a clean native prefix and construct one homogeneous U(q) offer (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Expose one actual clean native intermediate and construct a phase-bound homogeneous one-port offer. In the frozen #4610 backward supplier, replace helper496's actual paid H3 at event15372 (chart911 to full1) by H2 to existing Yport39 chart181, an owned COPY, then H1 to full1. The two children compose to the old operator exactly. The split alone preserves every original live field and the old632-input endpoint. Its exact paid change is **H2+H1−H3**; the buffer has no productive reward.

A separate source-bound construction uses explicit monomial input/output maps to obtain

```text
(X,Ytilde,C) = D (a+q*y, y+q*h, h),
H            = D*q*h,
```

where q=C162^-1, D is the actual commuting rank8 transverse word, and a,y,h are THREE original arbitrary owners. C is dependent owned workspace. The original helper output is read and restored once. The main Y endpoint changes deliberately in this homogeneous interface; it is not simultaneously credited as its old autonomous job. The conservative additional finite bill is36 array passes and one owned array, with precision allocation and compiler funding separate.

Raw Gamma has a square of Fourier grade2. Separate phase-exact monomial boundaries recover the homogeneous D/q model; no raw-Gamma monomial-square assumption is used. The construction is ONE resource. No112-resource capacity, two-call consumer, profitable caller, compiler/outer admission or new kappa is established.
